fields.text: Reading guide page 5 of 10: the shared _resolve_fault decision, the raw SIGSEGV handler used on base-linux, and the retry table. The claim to weigh: MAX_RETRIES (16) is a bounded mechanical limit, and a refusal kills the component rather than redirecting the request anywhere. About 20 minutes. Note on pace: pages 3 and 4 came back in under a minute each; if you are ratifying my reading rather than reading the lines yourself, say so in the notes box and I will record the review that way.
Page 5: all four claims confirmed. Page 6 is posted as q12 (fault handling on base-hw).
